name: litloop
description: LitLoop (Academic Paper Agent) turns academic paper search, download, Zotero filing and citation export into a reusable agent workflow. Derived from Rimagination/scansci-pdf.

interface.shortDescription: Search, organize, cite, and retrieve academic papers with MCP.
interface.longDescription: LitLoop gives Codex a research-paper workflow built around DOI and arXiv discovery, citation export, batch queues, metadata checks, open-access resolution, and user-authorized institutional access. It reports the source and result for each retrieval and keeps the full workflow available through a local MCP server. Derived from Rimagination/scansci-pdf (Apache-2.0).
defaultPrompt: Search for papers and return verified DOI records
Organize my paper list and export citations
Check LitLoop access and download readiness
